card.name: Start therapy under close supervision
card.fires_on: The word "under" right after "therapy/treatment should be started" in ACE inhibitor and ARB hypotension warnings, before "close medical supervision". It also fires weakly on verbs like "remain", "maintain", "Take" in precaution phrases.

modes.label: Started under supervision
modes.description: "under" after start or initiate treatment, leading into close medical supervision.
modes.example: In such patients, fosinopril sodium and hydrochlorothiazide tablet therapy should be started<< under>> close medical supervision; they should be followed

modes.label: Precaution verbs
modes.description: Verbs that begin advice about staying careful or keeping a target level.
modes.example: Patients and physicians should<< remain>> alert for signs and symptoms of GI ulcer
